desc:
🧠 Name something nobody else thinks of, and win! 🧠
Everyone at the table gets the same question. Common answers score a little. RARE answers score a lot!

🐶 "Name a pet"
• Dog = 10 points
• Fennec Fox = 90 points!

⭐ HOW TO PLAY
1. Walk up to a table and sit down
2. Read the question and type ONE answer
3. Everyone's answers are revealed together, from Common up to LEGENDARY (100 points!)
4. After 7 rounds, the highest score wins

✅ No speed bonus, so take your time and think
✅ Small spelling mistakes are okay
✅ New? Practice against the Noob at the practice tables!

🎮 PLAY YOUR WAY
• 1v1 duels
• 3-player battles
• 4-player tables
• 8-player tables on the main stage

📚 135+ questions about animals, food, countries, sports, science, music, video games and more!

🪑 Earn coins every match to unlock cool chairs, thrones and answer effects
🏆 Climb the leaderboards: Top Wins, Top Streaks and Best Score
🎁 Claim a free daily reward every day
